# Appropriation Ordinance No. 1, Series of 1990

**Appropriation Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance appropriates P319,134.56 from the General Fund and P9,456.00 from the Infrastructure Fund, sourced from the reversion of appropriation and balance of the annual budget. The funds are allocated for salary standardization, representation allowance, statutory obligations, and other operating expenses. The ordinance takes effect immediately and applies retroactively to January 1, 1990, for salary standardization of rank-and-file employees.

## Key Provisions

1.  Appropriates P319,134.56 from the General Fund and P9,456.00 from the Infrastructure Fund, derived from the balance of the Annual Budget and Reversion of Appropriation.
2.  Allocates the funds for salary standardization, representation allowance, statutory obligations like GSIS premiums, state insurance premiums, medicare and pag-ibig fund contributions, and other operating expenses of the municipal government of Pitogo, Quezon.
3.  Attaches Supplemental Budget both No. 1 for the General and Infrastructure Funds of the Municipal Government of Pitogo, Quezon as integral parts of the Appropriation Ordinance, marked as Annexes "A" and "B" respectively.
4.  Specifies that the salary standardization of all rank-and-file employees below the rank of the Municipal Government Assistant Department Head shall take effect retroactively to January 1, 1990.
5.  States that the appropriation ordinance shall take effect immediately.
